notes.title: Regular updates and content changes
notes.content:
[h2]Update content [/h2]
-Added a collection house as menu
-The function of real-time depth of field is improved, but it is not customized online. The default update threshold of focal length is 5
-HUD is optimized to look more comfortable
-Other UIs have also been optimized
[h2]Content change [/h2]
-The name of the game has been renamed [i]TheCollector [/i](the page of store and library has not been modified yet)
-See the official release for the game background

notes.title: The new level has been launched
notes.content:
[h1]In addition to the new level, the following adjustments have been made[/h1]
-Added a fully automatic weapon: Uzi
-The dynamic resolution system has been offline for adjustment and improvement
-The test version of the real-time depth of field system (simulating the variable focal length of the camera) has been launched
-Optimized death animation for hostile AI
-Removed event shortcuts for development testing
-And bug fixes
